culpritSource.quote: The accident is actually a murder. The culprit is Shingo Mizuguchi. First, Shingo knocked Arisa unconscious with the fire extinguisher inside the basket of the hot air balloon. Then, to pin the blame on Okuda, he pulled out a weave from his hot air balloon basket on the night before the contest and picked a fight with him. The proof that Shingo did it was the melted plastic on the hot air balloon in the shape of doll hands. The motive was that the stocks he bought with money he borrowed from his clients crashed and if he didn't return it soon, they were going to audit him next month. He murder

summary.en: As every year, Sonoko goes to the "Suzuki Balloon Festival", the largest national hot-air balloon race sponsored by her family at the Ibaraki Prefecture, but this time with Ran and Conan. The three go on Ayato Hasegawa's balloon, the receptionist who must record the video of the competition.

locations: Suzuki's Balloon Festival at the Ibaraki Prefecture
